description: Change a meeting you organized (from send_invite): new time, title, place, notes or guest list. Everyone invited gets the update; guests you drop get a cancellation. Pass invite_id and only the fields that change. Moving start alone keeps the meeting's length. An empty string clears location, meeting_url or description.

all_day.description: true makes it all-day (start as a date, unless it is all-day already); false gives it times again (pass start).

attendees.description: The FULL new guest list (replaces the old one). Omit to keep it.

credentials_dir.description: Credential directory for this call (default: ATOMIC_MAIL_CREDENTIALS_DIR or ~/.atomicmail). Use separate paths per account; see help topic multi_account.

end.description: New end. For an all-day event: the last day, inclusive.

start.description: New start (ISO 8601, or local with time_zone; a date with all_day).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the times are in, e.g. Europe/Moscow. Required when start/end have no UTC offset. Also used to write the date in the email.

name: update_invite
title: Update a meeting invitation
